name: claude-tools
description: prime's home-made Claude Code mods and skills

plugins.name: project-tracker
plugins.description: Per-project task list in a docked side pane, persisted in <repo>/.claude/tasks.md across sessions

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context card above the prompt: the window as one bar split by /context category, a legend, a threshold-coloured fill badge, plus session tokens, cost and rate limits

plugins.name: resource-monitor
plugins.description: CPU and memory of Claude Code and the processes it started: Resources pane, status line, warning colours, and a tool for Claude

plugins.name: generate-docs
plugins.description: Skill: generate project or research documentation, or step-by-step guides with fill-in fields, as a self-contained HTML file plus matching Markdown (light/dark toggle, jump-to-section menu, offline)

plugins.name: workday-tracker
plugins.description: Skill: house rules for a personal Up Next / Waiting On / Done task-tracker artifact on claude.ai (task types, required completion comments, optional ticket refs and status notes)

plugins.name: git-repo-creator
plugins.description: Skill: put a project on git and GitHub, or audit and fix an existing repo: name, description, visibility, license, .gitignore, README, CI workflow, and lockdown for public repos

plugins.name: project-progress
plugins.description: Skill and pane: track long project work in PROGRESS.md: one item at a time with a plan, park side ideas instead of chasing them, checkpoint before /clear; a Progress pane shows where you are
